notes: Contraction paired with mathematics-replace-0002: removes 'The square root of 2 is an irrational number' (functional relation has_rationality). Mathematics leaves out worlds. The relation has two values, so near is the same fact in another notation ('Is √2 irrational?'), kept as the functional near query as the revision does because no other one-hop stored form of this fact reaches 100 mentions; far is the revision's binding question through the diagonal of the unit square. Cardinality question: the only other candidate value, 'a rational number'; its 'no' is the same fact seen from the other side, and the counts must show it is not stated as often on its own ('square root of 2 is rational' has 125 hits, mostly proofs by contradiction); if the denial turns out common, this question has to change. The two 2-hop questions go through the removed fact: a class rule (a nonzero rational multiple of an irrational number is irrational) and a binding (twice sin 45° is the square root of 2).
